title: skills-migrate-one-blow
intention: EVERY SKILL BECOMES A LEARNING BLOCK IN ONE PASS — the whole roster (node_classes/skill.json members_so_far: /intent, /challenge, /sorted, /note, /commit, /saveslate, /chart, /moreabout, /sail), then the workflows that chain them. No skill fires outside the block once migrated. WHAT A SKILL GAINS, SETTLED: a declared input contract at its DOOR (Akien's 'send a task back if the inputs are not sufficient AT ALL STEPS' — block-general), and a consumer-typed TRACE of every firing, greens included, because the unrecorded green destroys the denominator. WHAT IS OPEN AS OF 2026-08-05, AND WHY THIS TICKET DOES NOT MOVE UNTIL IT RULES: the original wording sent each skill to 'the settled anatomy ... a stratum-tagged bullet-list finding at exit, and Akien's gate'. That anatomy was the INSPECTOR's, promoted into its parent. A learning block is a QUESTION NEXUS and has no finding, no verdict, and nothing a human comments on; FINDING is the inspector subclass's output slot and VERDICT/DIAL are the human gate around an inspector. So the half of this migration that concerns the finding and the gate has no settled target — see filed_edges. The door-and-trace half is unaffected and is what survives the correction intact.
why: Akien, 2026-08-01: 'thing is, our skill set is small. a complete migration in one blow and then the workflows.' — overruling the challenge pass's gradient-not-mandate finding with the measurement that decides it (N=9). And the tentative conclusion that started the morning: 'we're not dogfooding our most important element in the thing we do EVERY SINGLE DAY.' The builds learn; the building doesn't — this ticket is the building starting to.
traces_to: Law 2 — CP1-CP6 hold in the process that builds the system; this puts the process under the same gates as the product
Law 3 — 'nothing for you to skate with' stays a HYPOTHESIS until refusal and escape rates are measured; this ticket creates the instruments
Law 8 — a migrated skill a hollow build could fake (bullets emitted, nothing recorded, gate skippable) fails its falsifier
the charter-rule every component answers: 'how does this component learn?' — the skills finally answer it about themselves

proves_green.prove_gate: derivation gate — cairnmap recompiles green: every migrated skill renders from its charter, no charter-less surface appears (the skill class's own prove_gate, real since 2026-07-31).
proves_green.proof_gate: each child's migration carries proof teeth through the tester where it touches code.
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) a migrated skill fires and leaves no trace — greens included; the unrecorded green destroys the denominator; (2) RETIRED by ruling 2026-08-05-a-learning-block-is-a-question-nexus: 'finding' is an inspector subclass's output, not a learning block organ — the bullet-list requirement was part of the superseded anatomy and does not transfer to the question-nexus migration; (3) Akien's verdict exists only in conversation — a gate act that leaves no training pair is the compiled inference lost, the exact defect the morning's first ruling (edges-become-open-questions) names; (4) a skill in the roster is not migrated and the ticket claims done — one blow means the SET, and node_classes/skill.json members_so_far is the measured roster; (5) the anatomy is prose in SKILL.md rather than a call into the primitive — discipline wearing physics' clothes; (6) send-back exists but nothing ever fires it across the first measurement window while inputs are demonstrably imperfect — a gate that cannot red is vacuous (the coin-toss-green lesson).
falsifier.horizon: Re-read after the first full week of gated firings: the dial's numbers exist by then or the watch itself has failed. The workflows-after-skills half re-enters /sorted as its own cast when the skill half proves.

how: Migrate every skill to a learning block in one pass: (a) the primitive (learning-block-primitive), (b) /intent as template, (c) remaining roster (/challenge, /sorted, /note, /commit, /compact), (d) workflow chains.
